hero.intro: A practical workshop for managers and new leads. Guided journaling, visualisation and goal-setting frameworks help people name what holds them back and leave with a written 30-day plan.

image.alt: A client team in namaste after an on-site wellness workshop

shift.heading: For teams that need clarity, self-belief, and intentional action.
shift.body:
This workshop turns reflection into practical momentum. People identify limiting beliefs, define stronger goals
          and leave with a personal action plan they can use immediately.

rhythm.heading: Reflect, reframe, then move with intent.
rhythm.body:
The workshop is paced to move from honest self-observation into practical direction. It gives teams space to
          name blocks, reset their internal language, and leave with sharper personal goals.

steps.title: Reflect
steps.description: Guided journaling helps people see patterns, pressure points and the beliefs shaping their workday.

steps.title: Reframe
steps.description: Mindset exercises turn inner critic loops into clearer, more useful language for growth.

steps.title: Commit
steps.description: Goal-setting and accountability tools turn the workshop into a practical next-step plan.

pricing.intro: Every quote is fixed in writing before you commit, and depends on team size, location and format. GST invoice provided.

cards.description: A one-off reset for your team.
Recurring slots that build a habit.

pricing.note: Prices exclude GST and travel for offsite formats. Free rescheduling with 72 hours' notice.

items.question: Is this a lecture or hands-on?
items.answer: Hands-on. Journaling, vision-boarding and goal frameworks — people leave with a written action plan, not just notes.

items.question: How big can the group be?
items.answer: 8–40 works best for depth. Larger groups lose the personal reflection, so we cap or split.

items.question: Will this actually change behaviour or just feel good on the day?
items.answer: We build accountability frameworks and a 30-day action plan so it carries past the session.

items.question: Can you tailor it to managers vs individual contributors?
items.answer: Yes — we adjust the goal-setting and inner-critic work to the seniority mix you tell us about.

items.question: On-site or studio?
items.answer: Usually on-site as a workshop; studio works for smaller cohorts. We cover Gurgaon and Delhi-NCR.

items.question: What space do we need?
items.answer: A workshop-style room where people can sit in a circle or pods and write.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Quoted to your group size and duration. Get a fixed number on a quick call.

items.question: How far ahead should we book?
items.answer: 5–7 days is comfortable; we can move faster for urgent offsites.
